title: hebe divaricata
intro: Hebe divaricata, commonly known as the Snow Top or White Hebe, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is often used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hebe divaricata include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
